# 3 Axial Skyrmions
- This reflection reverses the sign of only one pion field, so the resulting relative phase differs by an added π compared with refs. [3, 12, 7], where the antiSkyrmion is produced by flipping the signs of all three pion fields.
- The convention adopted here is more natural for comparison with the analogous monopole case.
- The profile function vanishes at a radius of \(s/2\) from the center of the Skyrmion or antiSkyrmion, allowing the two to be joined smoothly while keeping the fields in the vacuum state outside their respective cores.
- Beyond the simple initial conditions given by ansatz (3.7), more advanced starting configurations were also employed using the rational map ansatz [11] with an axially symmetric charge \(n\) map.
